topics.title: Landlord approval and Kemlite site start

summary.text: The landlord approval arrived on the nineteenth. Kemlite starts on site on 4 January, as planned last week.

quotes.text: The landlord approval came on the nineteenth, so Kemlite starts on site on the fourth of January like as planned last week.

summary.text: Last week's plan assumed the approval would arrive. It has arrived, so the start date does not change.

quotes.text: Last week we planned it as the fourth, on the assumption that the approval would arrive. Now it has arrived, so the plan stays.

summary.text: Ravi said this closes only the approval and the site start, not everything.

summary.text: Kemlite submitted the SCDF application on the eighteenth. The inspection is booked for 5 February.

summary.text: Move-in stays on 23 February. That leaves about two weeks of buffer if the inspection asks for fixes.

quotes.text: No, we don't know that. That's why I kind of said if.
Better, not gone. That's my reading.

topics.title: Customer portal request for an earlier payment firewall opening

summary.text: For the Customer self-service portal project, Mei asked central IT to open the payment firewall in the second week of January instead of the last week.

quotes.text: For the customer portal, we'd like central IT you know to open the payment firewall in the second week of January instead of the last.

summary.text: This affects the office project because Jonas's team does the office network install in weeks three and four. The second week works only if the office does not need the team earlier.

quotes.text: My team is on the office network install in weeks three and four, so the second week is possible sort of only if the office doesn't need us earlier.

summary.text: Ravi confirmed the office does not need the team before week three. The request was agreed.

quotes.text: The office doesn't need you sort of before week three, so fine by us.
agreed: central IT opens the portal's kind of payment firewall in the second week of January.

quotes.text: The firewall agreement stands as it is, and this is a separate matter about the office.
